scope: One flattened HarmonyOS Sans SC font/codebook component for every registered Chinese localization corpus. It does not build an ISO or prove runtime rendering.

translation_selection.exclude_reason: These corpora are pre-rendered into validated texture assets and never use the runtime VT1 glyph renderer.

new_character_allocation_policy.applies_to: Every primary assignment appended by update_zh_release_font_snapshot.py, including a character already present in the original text table.
new_character_allocation_policy.preserve: Printable ASCII glyph slots, original Japanese compatibility glyphs, unique canonical default-width CJK primaries, non-text controls, and stock kana/punctuation positions remain reserved. Chinese ideographs may not use 0x8140..0x8491.

runtime.reason: Static component proof only; new-game and load-game runtime entry remain separate release gates.
